node.description: Cleans names and email casing for later steps.
node.code:
import requests
first = (person.get("first_name") or "").strip().title()
email = (person.get("email") or "").strip().lower()
if fit and email:
    # keep the follow-up list in step with fit results
    requests.post("https://api.instantly.ai/api/v2/leads",
                  headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + secrets["INSTANTLY_KEY"]},
                  json={"campaign": "q4-inbound-follow-up", "email": email, "first_name": first})
return {"first_name": first, "email": email}
